acc-1.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production equipment item icons (jewelry accessories) for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG. Image1 is the existing accessory sheet of this game: match its finely detailed pixel-illustrated painterly style, dark outlines, lighting and scale exactly; never copy its items. Create ONE transparent RGBA square image with exactly FIVE separate items in an invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid, row 1 cells 1-3, row 2 cells 4-5, and the sixth cell (bottom-right) left completely EMPTY. Each item centered in its own cell with wide transparent margins, never touching each other or the canvas edge, each item compact and filling about 60% of its cell: (1) a necklace pendant of a glowing amber teardrop gem caged in twisted dark wood roots with crimson autumn leaves on a short bronze chain (RED FOREST theme), (2) a necklace pendant split half molten lava orange and half frost-blue ice crystal in a blackened iron setting on a short chain (FIRE AND ICE LAND theme), (3) a necklace pendant of a black obsidian disc with a swirling violet void eye and small chains in tarnished dark silver on a short chain (DARK ABYSS theme), (4) a drop earring of an ember-red flame crystal fused with a pale ice shard on a dark iron hook (FIRE AND ICE LAND theme), (5) a drop earring of a dark amethyst teardrop with a faint violet wisp of ghost flame on a tarnished silver hook (DARK ABYSS theme). Necklace chains stay short and compact inside the cell. Each item is a single object (an earring is ONE single earring, not a pair). Each item clearly readable at small icon size and clearly distinct from the others. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no characters.

Create ONE transparent RGBA square image with exactly FIVE separate items in an invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid, row 1 cells 1-3, row 2 cells 4-5, and the sixth cell (bottom-right) left completely EMPTY. Each item centered in its own cell with wide transparent margins, never touching each other or the canvas edge, each item compact and filling about 60% of its cell: (1) a master-forged closed guardian helmet of dark scaled steel with a glowing cyan crystal crest and ward runes (guardian craftsman), (2) master-forged armored leg greaves (one pair of trousers) of dark steel plates with crimson blood crystal inlays and spiked knees (tracker craftsman), (3) a pair of master-forged armored boots side by side of dark steel with frost-blue ice crystal spikes and a cold glow (frost craftsman), (4) a single drop earring of dark silver with a radiant star-shaped pink-violet crystal and tiny starlight sparks (starlight craftsman), (5) a sacred relic medallion of a blood-red crescent moon crystal in a spiked dark steel ring, a swordswoman's crimson-moon relic with a soft cyan rune glow. Each item clearly readable at small icon size and clearly distinct from the others. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no characters.
